items.sourceText: After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of the LORD, saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”
items.reasonJa: カナン人集団への直接言及。初出ゲートは1:1。カナン人と戦う対象として初めて明記。

items.sourceText: Judah said to Simeon his brother, “Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot.” So Simeon went with him.
items.reasonJa: カナン人集団への直接言及。初出ゲートは1:1。ユダとシメオンが戦う相手として明記。

items.sourceText: Judah went up, and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.
items.reasonJa: カナン人集団への直接言及。初出ゲートは1:1。カナン人が戦闘集団として明記。

items.sourceText: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
items.reasonJa: カナン人集団への直接言及。初出ゲートは1:1。カナン人と戦ったことを明記。

items.sourceText: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland.
items.reasonJa: カナン人集団への直接言及。初出ゲートは1:1。山地・南部・低地に住むカナン人を明記。

items.sourceText: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
items.reasonJa: カナン人集団への直接言及。初出ゲートは1:1。ヘブロンのカナン人を明記。

items.sourceText: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.
items.reasonJa: カナン人集団への直接言及。初出ゲートは1:1。ゼファテに住むカナン人を明記。

items.sourceText: Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
items.reasonJa: カナン人集団への直接言及。初出ゲートは1:1。カナン人がその地に住み続けたと明記。

items.sourceText: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.
items.reasonJa: カナン人集団への直接言及。初出ゲートは1:1。イスラエルがカナン人を強制労働に就かせたと明記。

items.sourceText: Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.
items.reasonJa: カナン人集団への直接言及。初出ゲートは1:1。ゲゼルのカナン人を明記。

items.sourceText: Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.
items.reasonJa: カナン人集団への直接言及。初出ゲートは1:1。カナン人がゼブルンの人々の間に住むと明記。

items.sourceText: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they didn’t drive them out.
items.reasonJa: カナン人集団への直接言及。初出ゲートは1:1。アシェル人がカナン人の間に住むと明記。

items.sourceText: Naphtali didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but he lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and of Beth Anath became subject to forced labor.
items.reasonJa: カナン人集団への直接言及。初出ゲートは1:1。ナフタリがカナン人の間に住むと明記。

items.sourceText: the five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.
items.reasonJa: カナン人集団への直接言及。初出ゲートは1:1。「すべてのカナン人」と民族集団を明記。

items.sourceText: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
items.reasonJa: カナン人集団への直接言及。初出ゲートは1:1。イスラエルがカナン人を含む諸民族の間に住むと明記。

items.sourceText: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;
items.reasonJa: ダン族を山地へ押し上げた相手としてアモリ人を明示。

items.sourceText: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.
items.reasonJa: アモリ人の居住地とヨセフ族の従属関係を記す。

items.sourceText: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
items.reasonJa: アモリ人の境界を述べる。

items.sourceText: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
items.reasonJa: イスラエルの民が他の民とともに住んだ集団として明示。

items.sourceText: I said to you, “I am the LORD your God. You shall not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell.” But you have not listened to my voice.’”
items.reasonJa: 預言者の引用中でアモリ人の地の神々に言及。

items.sourceText: They troubled and oppressed the children of Israel that year. For eighteen years they oppressed all the children of Israel that were beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
items.reasonJa: ギレアデのアモリ人の地という地域・集団用法を記す。

items.sourceText: The LORD said to the children of Israel, “Didn’t I save you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
items.reasonJa: 主がアモリ人から救ったと述べる。

items.sourceText: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, ‘Please let us pass through your land to my place.’
items.reasonJa: シホンをアモリ人の王と呼ぶ。

items.sourceText: The LORD, the God of Israel, delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they struck them. So Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
items.reasonJa: アモリ人シホンと民について述べる。

items.sourceText: They possessed all the border of the Amorites, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and from the wilderness even to the Jordan.
items.reasonJa: アモリ人の境界を述べる。

items.sourceText: So now the LORD, the God of Israel, has dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and should you possess them?
items.reasonJa: アモリ人の地をめぐるエフタの主張。

items.sourceText: The children of Benjamin didn’t drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.
items.reasonJa: エルサレムに住むエブス人を集団として明示。

items.sourceText: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
items.reasonJa: イスラエルの民が住んだ諸集団の一つとして明示。

items.sourceText: When they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said to his master, “Please come and let’s enter into this city of the Jebusites, and stay in it.”
items.reasonJa: エブス人の町という集団名と、直前の地名エブスを区別して明示。
